about_the_game:
🐾 About the Game

Wake up as Katie, a curious catgirl with black hair, green eyes, and a restless hunger for fish. After a dream of chasing her perfect catch, Katie realizes her house is empty and her stomach is growling. Donning her mysterious shapeshifting bikini, she sets out on a whimsical adventure filled with puzzles, exploration, and playful surprises.

🌸 A Living, Interactive World
Every corner of Catgirl Simulator is designed to be touched, read, and discovered. Flip through books full of lore, gaze at paintings that hold hidden meaning, play with catnip that alters your experience, and uncover figurines and artifacts that bring the world to life. An AI narrator guides you through the journey while immersive, AI-enhanced imagery makes the adventure feel vibrant and alive.

🧩 Puzzles Without Repetition
At the heart of Catgirl Simulator lies its greatest strength: puzzles. Every challenge you face is different from the last. No two riddles, mazes, or brainteasers feel the same, ensuring the game is constantly fresh, clever, and full of surprises.

💡 A Passionate Experiment
Created by a single developer as a heartfelt surprise for a missing friend, Catgirl Simulator is a project made with love and curiosity. Built entirely in RPG Maker without custom programming, it showcases how much can be done with creativity, dedication, and storytelling alone. This is Superfantastic Production’s very first RPGMAKER game, and it wears its experimental heart proudly on its sleeve.

✨ Features:

  • Play as Katie, a witty and charming catgirl on a quest for fish

  • A highly interactive world filled with details to discover

  • AI narration that reacts to your journey

  • Collectible figurines and artifacts to aid your adventure

  • A wide variety of unique puzzles with no filler or repetition

  • A one-of-a-kind indie RPG Maker experience

Hungry for adventure? Hungry for fish?
Join Katie on her quirky, puzzle-filled quest in Catgirl Simulator!

short_description: After dreaming of catching a fish in the clouds, a hungry catgirl wakes with a craving only the perfect fish can satisfy. With none in sight, she sets off on an epic, puzzle-filled journey through space and time—meeting quirky friends and chasing a fish worthy of her feline desires.
